## DWE
### 0.3.3 Change Log
> **Important:** Use the same DWE 0.3.3 build on the client and server.
#### Global
##### Added
* Added vehicle-pack choices for reinforcements, gun runs, and compatible bombing support.
* Added AshVehicle client compatibility when entering worlds with Superb Warfare.
* Added defensive stops for ground vehicles with damaged tracks or wheels.
* Added switching to usable independent secondary weapons when ground vehicle turrets fail.
* Added NPC crew and passenger evacuation from ground vehicles with failed engines.
* Added B-2 and GBU-57 tactical air support with stabilized attack runs when AshVehicles is installed.
* Added consumable tactical orders with WWII radio and rugged tablet appearances.
* Added server JSON tactics linking bombardment, gun runs, vehicles, and NPC movement.
* Added tactical order editing, linked gimmick editing, appearance selection, limits, and item issuance.
* Added held ground targeting that confirms coordinates and heading when the hold completes.
* Added tactical order consumption on server acceptance and persistent shared cooldowns.
* Added four bundled tactical presets for precision strikes, line bombing, tank reinforcements, and combined support.
* Added per-tactic hold duration, range, and movement permissions, shown in tactical item tooltips.
* Added tactical ground previews, perspective direction guides, and visual and audio acceptance or failure feedback.
* Added horizontal or vertical tactical charge bars with configurable guide and bar colors.
* Added distinct radio and tablet sounds with per-tactic JSON customization.
* Added a tactical gauge rendering API for scripted HUD integrations.
##### Fixed
* Fixed blocked vehicle target tag input and text loss when resizing.
##### Changed
* Changed Warfare editor selection to show editor types beside details and contextual source actions.
##### Improved
* Improved editor toolbars with separators between action groups.
#### Forge 1.20.1
##### Fixed
* Fixed keyboard crashes in vehicle settings and entry screens.
